risk_if_not_implemented: Without Communicating Authorized Work Locations, trusted insiders may misuse access or act on conflicts of interest without detection or deterrence. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of a security-minded workforce (R-SA-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Remote Access
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to define, control and review organization-approved, secure remote access methods.
compensating_control_1.justification: Remote Access (NET-26) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Communicating Authorized Work Locations (HRS-17.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Physical & Environmental Protections
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the operation of physical and environmental protection controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Physical & Environmental Protections (PES-02) provides physical access control that compensates for the absence of Communicating Authorized Work Locations (HRS-17.1) by preventing unauthorized physical interaction with systems and infrastructure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
